subject: Vendor enablement kickoff — action checklist & MAP owners/timeline
messages:
From: Ethan Brooks <ethan@brightline.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@brightline.io>, procurement@brightline.io
Date: 2026-11-30T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Brightline vendor setup — kickoff & PO routing

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Brightline is ready to start vendor onboarding for the Redwood integration. We'd like to schedule an initial kickoff to walk through the vendor intake checklist, confirm PO routing and billing contacts, and align on a mutual action plan (MAP) so we can hit our internal go-live target in Q1.

Attached: brightline-vendor-questionnaire.docx (filled by our procurement team).

We are available next week on the following windows:
- Mon 12/1: 09:30–12:00 PT
- Tue 12/2: 10:00–12:30 PT

If you can propose a 30–45m slot and share the typical agenda, that would be great. Also: who at Redwood should we expect to own the PO path / billing conversation?

Best,
Ethan Brooks
VP, Procurement
Brightline Systems

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Brooks <ethan@brightline.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T11:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Brightline vendor setup — kickoff & PO routing

Hi Ethan — great to hear. Wed 12/2 11:00 AM PT or Thu 12/3 9:30 AM PT both work for our team; I can send a calendar invite for the first if that fits Brightline.

I've attached a vendor onboarding checklist and our MAP template to streamline the call: vendor-onboarding-checklist.xlsx, mutual-action-plan-template.xlsx. High-level MAP owners we'd assign from Redwood:
- Procurement point: (Brightline) — Ethan / Marta
- Contracts: Ethan
- Finance & PO owner: please confirm (Brightline)
- Technical onboarding: Laura Bennett (cc'd)
- Customer success / AE: Vivek Kulkarni (cc'd)

Pre-call ask: please confirm the PO contact name/email and any billing details (entity name, billing address, PO number process). If you can also list the internal stakeholders who should join from the Brightline side (finance, legal, network), that will help us keep the call focused.

Reference: HubSpot deal RINF-2026-0897 (I'll attach the MAP in Drive during the invite).

Thanks — I'll hold Wed 12/2 11:00 PT tentatively and send an invite once you confirm.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Manager, Procurement Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@brightline.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Brooks <ethan@brightline.io>, procurement@brightline.io
Date: 2026-12-01T08:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Brightline vendor setup — kickoff & PO routing

Hi Karthik — thanks for the quick turnaround. Wed 12/2 at 11:00 AM PT works for our team; please send the invite.

PO/billing details: the PO owner is James O'Neil <james.oneil@brightline.io> (copied below). Billing entity: Brightline Systems LLC, EIN XX-XXXXXXX. We'll attach a PO-stub for your finance team to review.

Technical stakeholders joining: network@brightline.io and infra-team@brightline.io — they will be able to answer questions on firewall/IPs and test account provisioning.

Security items: can you confirm which evidence you need during onboarding? We typically provide SOC 2 Type II report, DPA, and a basic network requirements worksheet — happy to provide what you need.

Attached: PO-stub.pdf

Regards,
Marta Lopez
Head of Procurement Operations
Brightline Systems

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@brightline.io>, Ethan Brooks <ethan@brightline.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T12:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Brightline vendor setup — kickoff & PO routing

Thanks, Marta — invite coming through for Wed 12/2 11:00 AM PT.

Agenda (30–40m):
1) Introductions & scope (5m)
2) Vendor intake checklist walkthrough (15m) — I will review the onboarding checklist and required docs.
3) PO & billing path (10m) — confirm PO owner (James) and next steps for issuing a purchase order.
4) MAP alignment: owners, milestone dates, quick win targets (15m)
5) Security/compliance evidence + next steps (10m)

Success criteria for this kickoff:
- PO owner and billing entity confirmed (James)
- Redwood and Brightline have a shared MAP with owners and target dates
- Security evidence matrix and initial docs are identified and scheduled for delivery

Quick MAP draft (link below):
- Procurement signoff: 12/09/2026 — Owner: Ethan / Marta
- PO issued: 12/16/2026 — Owner: James
- Technical onboarding & test environment: 12/23/2026 — Owner: Laura

Drive MAP: https://drive.redwood.com/s/driveid/MAP-Brightline-v1 (attached MAP-Brightline-v1.pdf).

On Mon, Dec 1, Marta Lopez wrote: "PO/billing details: the PO owner is James O'Neil..."

We'll cover network requirements and firewall IP ranges on the call; Laura will own that thread after kickoff.

Thanks all — sending calendar invite now.

—Karthik

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@brightline.io>, Ethan Brooks <ethan@brightline.io>
Date: 2026-12-02T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Brightline vendor setup — kickoff & PO routing

Quick note ahead of today's call: happy to own technical onboarding and initial test account setup. For the network checklist, please provide the following prior to the call if possible so I can confirm on the spot:
- Allowed inbound IP ranges (CIDR) for Brightline test agents
- Firewall rules and any NAT/GW details we should be aware of
- If you have a staging VPC or preferred region for test workloads

I've attached our network-reqs.pdf with the details we typically ask for. On the call I'll cover steps for creating test API keys, sandbox quotas, and baseline validation tests.

See you at 11:00 PT.

Laura Bennett
Lead Technical Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
